info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Feedback Submission API
info.description: The Customer Feedback Submission API enables businesses to gather and analyze customer reviews regarding servicing activities across multiple channels. By submitting feedback through this endpoint, organizations can enhance their service quality and customer satisfaction. The API primarily deals with customer reviews as a resource and supports the analysis of customer sentiments regarding their experience. Typical consumers of this API include customer service teams and product managers looking to improve service based on user insights.

post.summary: Submit a review for the servicing activity analysis.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit their reviews regarding the servicing activity analysis for the specified resource. Providing insights and feedback will help improve the analysis and service quality.
